universal_lens: A Bayesian-structured lens for probabilistic inference across multi-modal sports data streams using conformal predictive distributions. Deep learning architectures unify spatial-temporal data processing in sports analytics through probabilistic inference and kernel-based feature extraction.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs a conformal predictive framework to map observed kinematic and physiological signals into actionable performance metrics via Bayesian belief updates. Bayesian inference maps deep learning outputs to performance likelihood distributions using conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification.
gse_mapping: GSE utilizes a state-transition graph to model dynamic shifts in athlete performance states, informed by real-time sensor fusion and deep learning embeddings. Situational reasoning models use state-transition graphs to predict athlete behavior and tactical shifts based on real-time kinematic data.

primitives.name: Deep Learning Framework for Sports Analysis
primitives.verbatim_quote: Eligible studies were those that explicitly applied deep learning techniques (such as convolutional and recurrent neural networks) to sports performance analysis tasks (e.g., action recognition and classification, motion detection and tracking, injury prediction) and reported their methodology and performance metrics.
primitives.assumptions: Deep learning models are trained on labeled datasets of sports actions and outcomes; model generalization assumes similar environmental and biomechanical conditions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When input data deviates significantly from training distribution or when model architecture lacks sufficient capacity for task complexity.

layer2.mapping: The framework maps sensor and video inputs to structured feature spaces through CNNs and RNNs, enabling GSI to compute posterior probabilities of performance outcomes.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of action classification and prediction error rates.

primitives.name: Methodological Standardization in Sports Research
primitives.verbatim_quote: Methods We conducted a systematic literature search of Web of Science Core Collection (WOS), China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), and Association for Computing Machinery Digital Library (ACM DL) for relevant studies published from 2015 to 2024, with no language restrictions.
primitives.assumptions: Systematic review protocols ensure reproducibility and comparability of findings across studies; no language restriction allows for global data inclusivity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When inconsistent reporting standards or incomplete methodological descriptions prevent meta-analysis or replication.

layer2.mapping: Standardized methodology enables GSE to aggregate and synthesize research findings into a unified knowledge base for decision-making.
layer2.telemetry: Number of studies meeting inclusion criteria and consistency in reported metrics.

primitives.name: Performance Prediction Through Temporal Modeling
primitives.verbatim_quote: CNNs were the most common models for visual recognition tasks, while RNNs (including LSTMs) were frequently used for temporal sequence data.
primitives.assumptions: Temporal dependencies in motion data are adequately captured by recurrent architectures; visual features are separable and discriminative.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When temporal coherence is disrupted due to sensor noise or abrupt behavioral changes.

layer2.mapping: RNN-based temporal modeling aligns with GSE's state evolution logic, allowing prediction of future performance states based on current and past observations.
layer2.telemetry: Prediction accuracy of performance trajectories and injury risk scores.

primitives.verbatim_quote: Architecture The architecture of deep learning systems typically encompasses structural design, training procedures, eval­ uation metrics, and tool parameters.
primitives.assumptions: System assumes modular design with configurable layers for training and evaluation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs under insufficient data or misaligned training objectives.

layer2.mapping: GSI's Bayesian network mirrors architectural components via probabilistic node relationships; GSE's state machine reflects layer transitions.

primitives.name: Convolutional Neural Networks
primitives.verbatim_quote: CNNs consist of interconnected layers designed to process structured image data, making them particularly effective for extracting information from static frames [43].
primitives.assumptions: Spatial locality of features is preserved through convolutional filters.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Performance degrades with high-dimensional temporal input without 3D extension.

layer2.mapping: GSI uses CNN kernels for feature extraction from video frames; GSE applies kernelized similarity for motion trajectory clustering.

primitives.name: Recurrent Neural Networks

primitives.assumptions: Sequential dependencies can be captured through recurrent connections.

primitives.assumptions: Combination of spatial and temporal feature extraction improves recognition accuracy.

primitives.verbatim_quote: the core advantage of the YOLO model is its convolutional feature sharing and single-stage regres­ sion structure, which maintains high speed output and can be seamlessly integrated with lightweight data asso­ ciation strategies [28].
primitives.assumptions: Assumes static or slowly varying environmental conditions and sufficient computational resources for real-time processing.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When computational constraints exceed acceptable latency thresholds or when feature overlap leads to ambiguous associations.

primitives.verbatim_quote: The third category is the multi-feature fusion approach, which improves the robustness of MOT by integrating the information of appearance, motion trajectory and pose key points [60].
primitives.assumptions: Assumes availability of complementary sensory inputs (appearance, motion, pose) and effective integration algorithms.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When individual features fail due to occlusion or lighting variation, leading to degraded tracking performance.
